rules.statement: A vendor who sells without title and subsequently acquires title cannot set it up against a purchaser from him, but this does not apply to subsequent purchasers.
rules.supporting_quote: If the fifth defendant, when he purchased, failed to search the register, or bought the share notwithstanding the registration, he accepted a serious risk, but I fail to see that he is in the same position as a vendor who sells when he has no title to give, and subsequently, when he has obtained title, repudiates the sale and sets up his newly acquired title against his purchaser. The element of fraud involved in the latter transaction is wanting in the purchase by the fifth defendant.

meta.parties: Mohammed Bhoy Et Al. v. Lebbe Marikar Et Al
